ipa.curves.zc_curves.Definition

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves.zc_curves.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    *,
    constituents: Constituents = None,
    curve_definition: ZcCurveDefinitions = None,
    curve_parameters: ZcCurveParameters = None,
    curve_tag: OptStr = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
    shift_scenarios: ShiftScenario | None = None,
    outputs: OptStrStrs = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
constituents Constituents No None
curve_definition ZcCurveDefinitions No None
curve_parameters ZcCurveParameters No None
curve_tag OptStr No None
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters.
shift_scenarios ShiftScenario | None No None The list of attributes applied to the curve shift scenarios.
outputs OptStrStrs No None

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None Callable function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

Example

import lseg.data.content.ipa.curves.zc_curves as zc_curves
definition = zc_curves.Definition(
    curve_definition=zc_curves.ZcCurveDefinitions(
        currency="CHF",
        name="CHF LIBOR Swap ZC Curve",
        discounting_tenor="OIS",
    ),
    curve_parameters=zc_curves.ZcCurveParameters(
        use_steps=True
    )
)
response = definition.get_data()

# Using get_data_async

import asyncio
task = definition.get_data_async()
response = asyncio.run(task)
